notes.title: Major Class Update!
notes.notes:
Hello again, pilots! I present another semi-large scaled content update to The Cruise 2! 

Patch Notes

New Class: Blitz

The Blitz class is back from The Cruise 1.0, this time with more powerful and explosive weaponry, homing missiles, tactical nukes, a lot of explosives to deal devastating AoE damage to enemies. 

New Class: Phantom

The Phantom class is a brand new class added to The Cruise 2. It charges up its abilities by killing enemies and taking their soul energy. It shoots magic type bullets which can pierce armor easily. 

New Class: Stalker

The Stalker class is also a brand new addition to The Cruise 2. It shoots extremely powerful bullets at a moderate pace, it focuses on dealing massive damage with less bullets. Whiffing your shots might be really penalizing if you don't have great movement to make up for it. 

New Ally: Mender

A new ally: the Mender appears! As stated in its name, the Mender repairs ally ships around it at a constant rate, it can also provide your ship with some repairs as well. It cannot attack enemies, and play purely a support role. 

New Ally: Shielder

The Shielder has a lot of health and armor, it also fires off small null fields to destroy enemy bullets. This will greatly help you and your forces. It cannot attack enemies. 

Dialog System

I have added a dialog system to setup for the campaign mode, you can see it in action when you first load into the game, there will be a new tutorial dialog to help new players. The tutorial dialog won't show up a second time, only the first time you load up the game after this update. Unless you do some file modification and change the value "FirstStart" to true in the "settings.tcrs" file in "AppData/LocalLow/Eternity Studios/The Cruise" folder *wink* *wink*.

Also fixed a bunch of bugs and added some abilities and passives to already existing classes. Tested the game with really bad computers and they still run at 60 FPS... What an achievement. Speaking of achievements, I will be adding some achievements to The Cruise 2. And no, they won't be glitched. 

Have a wonderful day (or night)!

notes.title: Content Update!
notes.notes:
Hello, fellow pilots! The Cruise 2.0 is getting a content update! Adding 1 new class to play with and 1 new type of enemy to play against! 

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41229924/0a9f59f2e6265562be7e1efccde2b291a8d76b3a.png

Patch Notes

New Class: Mend 

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41229924/6593168936771fc7054acc5de837aee8b169ceb9.png

We are bringing back Mend from The Cruise 1.0! Its nano repair bots will continue to shine and repair in The Cruise 2.0! 

New Ability: Burst Heal

Releases bursts of repair nanobots at once into an area. Repairing allies as well as the spacecraft itself. 

New Passive: Healing

Passively mends the spacecraft. 

New Bullet: Concentrated Plasma 

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41229924/e4110b0018208158f03bf5bf9a0c3b42a8d278a9.png

A type of plasma bullet that is used by the Mend class, it has a curved path, as well as higher damage than normal plasma. 

New Enemy Type: Toxic Trilobytes

Low and behold, the race of Toxic Trilobytes have returned! They have lost their poisoning bullets, instead opt for homing bullets and mass amounts of curving bullets. Watch out for those cross shaped curving bullets {STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41229924/b449d99f8cda1dc23f5c2bcc0d54dfe27aeb8306.png as you outmaneuver the homing ones {STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41229924/b2bf9bf1b847cd5e36abe5a3fdceae52f813044c.png ! 

New Enemy: Crystalfly 

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41229924/7816186045157627878f31eb78ee4b9002a06297.png

Basic Trilobyte, seems to be composed of crystal-like substances, is slightly harder to take out than Human Drones or Parasite Ecaflips. 

New Enemy: Shieldfly 

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41229924/7a922e9f1078b73e085bb76ad890acd1d4338d10.png

Heavily armored Trilobyte, weak bullets does almost nothing to its hardened shell, might need some heavy firepower for these creatures. 

New Enemy: Cannonfly 

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41229924/90520046d6eb07fe4c5dfe9d5bf03efffc26c104.png

Able to produce mass amounts of curving bullets, could be devastating to be right in their line of fire. 

New Boss: Crystallic Queen 

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41229924/0b969df2437b8b401d52b722e00cb5e1c99ff95d.png

Mutated from a normal Parasite Queen, the Crystallic Queen is covered in crystal-like substance, it can produce Crystalflies in mass bursts without much consequences. 

Concluding Regards

That marks the end of the patch notes! I hope you all enjoy the new content, I will continue to work on The Cruise 2.0, re-adding things from 1.0 and creating new content. I also added MacOS support for The Cruise 2.0, so Mac users can also have fun playing the game! Have a nice day!

notes.title: Patch v1.7.2
notes.notes:
Note From Dev(s)
Goooood day everyone! We have released a patch for The Cruise! We have found a few issues with the game, we have fixed some of them in this patch. People are also saying that the crosshair is too small and just gets lost, so we changed that as well! Feel free to provide feedback to us in the discord! 

Discord: https://discord.com/invite/zGpMVrpgDE

Also we have added a button in the game for you guys to report bugs easily with a google form. 

Somewhat Major Changes
- Renamed All Classes
- Added Boss Rush Mode
- Added Bug Report
- Fixed Audio Issues
- Game Optimization

Warning
Previous Saves Most Likely Won't Be Compatible With Newer Versions, So If Necessary, Please Manually Clear Data.
